- A blasting cap (you can purchase this online or use a small amount of dynamite)

- A metal plug (to seal the other end of the pipe)
- A length of wire (to connect the blasting cap to the black powder)

Next, you will need to attach the metal plug to the other end of the pipe, making sure it is securely in place.
